preprocessing: Train-only quantile-to-normal, 93 local attributes; time and supplied aggregates excluded
selection_rule: Mean evaluation AP gain >=0.002, no mean F1 regression, AP non-regression in >=2/3 windows
threshold_rule: Tune threshold and neural stopping only on inner tuning block; freeze for evaluation

pruning_proof.explanation: Every missing seed is assigned AP=1.0. Fewer than two windows can still match the incumbent.

limitations: Development comparison on previously observed historical periods, not a fresh final test
Two seeds and fixed CPU-sized configurations; no exhaustive hyperparameter search
Graph context available within a period; feature publication times not verified
Overlapping expanding training windows; six runs are not six independent datasets
pruning_rule: Reject when perfect missing-seed AP scores cannot recover the existing two-window consistency requirement
source_status: Historical experiment source fingerprints; retired comparison scripts and rejected standalone models removed during cleanup. Current retained-model trainer: src/train_random_forest.py.
